finish_summary: Discrepancies: 1) apply_discount rounding off by .01; 2) bulk_discount_percent thresholds wrong for quantity=10 (returns 10% instead of 5%); 3) parse_coupon does not strip whitespace, raising ValueError on " save25 "; 4) Cart.items includes entries with zero quantity after removal; 5) subtotal calculation incorrect: total reported as 874.0 vs expected 834.0 due to wrong discount application; 6) total for member + coupon returns 300.0 instead of 315.0 because shipping fee not halved correctly.
